senses.gloss: m. (corrupt. of אִיסְקוּדְרָא, Pers. iskodâr; Koh. Ar.; v. אִיסְקוּנְדְּרֵי) courier.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 1:4:4">Y. Ab. Zar. I, 39ᵈ</cite> top <he>יהב תרתין וכ׳</he> he gave two pounds of pepper to a courier (to go to Tyre), and he (the courier) went up and found &c.
